decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line release-note entry, "Create #sig-cli", that links to PR #6508 [ev-2a78eeb28a35]. It doesn't name any product artifact, such as an API field, flag, CLI command or behaviour, and doesn't say what was created or changed. It also says nothing about who is exposed or what happens if an operator does nothing. The title suggests a community or governance item, but confirming that it has no product effect needs the PR content or a fuller description.
